text:
ITEM 1 | Sliced sausage rounds, medium-brown to dark reddish-brown with slightly glossy, browned casing and some caramelized edges; about 16-18 pieces, each roughly 2.5-3 cm diameter and 1-1.5 cm thick, clustered in the upper-left half of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Cubed potatoes, pale yellow-cream interior with golden-tan roasted/browned edges and a matte, slightly dry surface; pieces roughly 2-3 cm cubes, piled loosely on the right side of the plate next to the sausage | 130
ITEM 3 | Whole red grapes, dark maroon to purplish-red with smooth, slightly waxy skin and a subtle sheen; about 20 grapes roughly 1.5-2 cm across, clustered in the lower-center of the plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Single pale green grape, smooth translucent skin with slight sheen, about 2 cm across, sitting among the sausage and red grapes near the center of the plate | 5
